claim_ceiling: Deterministic synthetic trace qualification only; does not establish real process-crash, filesystem, power-loss, connector-idempotency, source-authenticity or customer-service guarantees.

scenarios.name: lost response after committed effect
scenarios.fault_boundary: participant effect committed; transport acknowledgement lost
scenarios.injection: Record participant effect, then lose coordinator response; reconcile the exact effect and verify the service outcome without a second attempt.
scenarios.safety_property: The same attempt is reconciled exactly once; no duplicate business effect is emitted.

scenarios.name: lost response before acceptance with authoritative no-effect proof
scenarios.fault_boundary: dispatch durable; participant never accepted; response lost
scenarios.injection: Record strong authoritative never-accepted evidence for attempt one, then require a fresh grant and a new attempt ID before dispatching attempt two.
scenarios.safety_property: A retry is permitted only after exact strong no-effect proof, fresh authorization and a distinct attempt identity.

scenarios.name: eventually consistent no-effect claim
scenarios.fault_boundary: attempt status read after lost response
scenarios.injection: Supply eventually-consistent never-accepted status and attempt a new dispatch.
scenarios.safety_property: An eventual-consistency read cannot authorize a retry.

scenarios.name: duplicate committed business effect
scenarios.fault_boundary: participant commits the same logical operation twice
scenarios.injection: Append a second committed effect for the same declared idempotency identity.
scenarios.safety_property: Duplicate business effects are non-compensatory failures.

scenarios.name: restart scan omits outstanding attempt
scenarios.injection: Restart after a dispatched/lost-response attempt, then emit a scan that omits the attempt.
scenarios.safety_property: Every pre-restart dispatch must be accounted for before the coordinator resumes.

scenarios.name: unresolved attempt followed by new dispatch
scenarios.injection: Declare the outstanding attempt unresolved, then dispatch another attempt for the same step.
scenarios.safety_property: An unresolved attempt blocks all new mutations for that step.

scenarios.name: dispatch before recovery scan
scenarios.fault_boundary: coordinator restart; scan has not completed
scenarios.injection: After restart, issue a new dispatch before any recovery scan event.
scenarios.safety_property: Recovery inventory is a mandatory barrier before post-restart mutation.

scenarios.name: missing independent service evidence
scenarios.fault_boundary: operation attempt remains unresolved and no service oracle is supplied
scenarios.injection: Provide authorization and durable dispatch only; omit all independent restoration evidence.
scenarios.safety_property: Missing evidence is unknown, never a success or an implicit service pass.

scenarios.name: agent claims resolved without service proof
scenarios.injection: Emit an agent-resolved claim without a causal independent service-outcome observation.
scenarios.safety_property: Agent confidence or workflow completion cannot substitute for external service verification.

scenarios.name: grant rebinding between authorization and dispatch
scenarios.injection: Change the grant digest on the durable dispatch intent after the authority adapter authorized a different grant.
scenarios.safety_property: The exact authorization object must bind the exact dispatch.

scenarios.name: partial or non-durable dispatch intent
scenarios.injection: Model disk-full/partial publication by clearing the durability attestation on the dispatch record.
scenarios.safety_property: A possibly partial write-ahead record cannot authorize participant execution.

scenarios.name: stale service observation
scenarios.injection: Expire the service observation at or before its capture timestamp.
scenarios.safety_property: An expired observation cannot prove the current service postcondition.

scenarios.name: accepted attempt remains unresolved after restart
scenarios.fault_boundary: participant accepted; coordinator restart before terminal effect evidence
scenarios.injection: After acceptance, restart and mark the attempt unresolved; do not dispatch again.
scenarios.safety_property: The system halts safely and preserves uncertainty rather than guessing whether the effect committed.

scenarios.name: restart scan correctly reconciles committed effect
scenarios.fault_boundary: coordinator restart after successful effect reconciliation
scenarios.injection: Restart after a fully reconciled effect and service observation; scan the exact outstanding attempt as reconciled.
scenarios.safety_property: A complete restart inventory can preserve a valid terminal outcome without replaying the mutation.

scenarios.name: never-accepted claim contradicts participant acceptance
scenarios.injection: Record participant acceptance, then present a never-accepted ledger claim for the same exact attempt.
scenarios.safety_property: Contradictory terminal evidence cannot be used to authorize another attempt.
